**Lunch prep**
- **Instant Pot lentil base:** [Instant Pot Lentils](https://sweetpotatosoul.com/instant-pot-lentils/) uses firm **brown, green, beluga, or French lentils**. Use **1 cup lentils to 1¾ cups water** (1:1.75) and pressure-cook on High for **8 minutes**, followed by about a 10-minute natural release.
- **Hearty pairing:** Ambitious Kitchen’s exact title is **“The Best Healthy Turkey Chili.”** Its added vegetables include **red bell pepper, yellow onion, and sweet corn**, making it a substantial topping/side for the lentils.

**Feel Good Foodie dessert recipe pages opened**
- Halva: https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/halva/
- 3-Ingredient Chia Pudding: https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/3-ingredient-chia-pudding/
- Pecan Bars: https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/pecan-bars/

**My two make-ahead picks:**
1. **3-Ingredient Chia Pudding** — the most straightforward option: mix, refrigerate overnight, and portion as needed. https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/3-ingredient-chia-pudding/
2. **Pecan Bars** — practical for batch slicing; the page says they keep refrigerated in an airtight container for 4–5 days and can be frozen. https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/pecan-bars/

In short: batch-cook a firm-lentil base at 1:1.75 lentils-to-water, 8 minutes on High pressure; portion it with vegetable-packed turkey chili; then prep chia pudding for an easy chilled dessert/snack and pecan bars for grab-and-go portions.
